contracts: Normalize multiple owner handoff schema versions while preserving exact authority fields and surfacing missing authority as errors/warnings.
Validate handoff source_commit reachability and ancestry within the declared owner branch without using moving branch HEAD as a pin.
Preserve stale blockers as SUPERSEDED_BY_PROVIDER_EVIDENCE and require RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED until the consumer proves the newer exact provider pin.
Classify blockers into PRODUCT_IMPLEMENTATION, CONTRACT_RECONCILIATION, LIVE_DEPLOYMENT, EXTERNAL_SECRET, DNS_TLS or REAL_BROWSER_ACCEPTANCE.
Produce deterministic SHA256 pin digest from sorted owner + exact source_commit + contract digest records.
Keep WS07 numbered migrations distinct from service-owned migrations and fail duplicate numbered/ledger collisions.
Report READY_TO_FREEZE_AFTER_OWNER_COMPLETION only; never select a WS50 child candidate or freeze a final provider set.

tested_ci_evidence.scope: Existing C3 pilot contract tests plus new domain-live generic schema/stale-blocker/credential/migration/pin-digest/source-validation/classification tests.

consumer_requirements: Morning coordinator supplies the completed exact owner handoff files for the target release_id.
The coordinator treats validator source_commit pins and pin_digest as the candidate input identity; observed moving branch heads are evidence only.
Any SUPERSEDED_BY_PROVIDER_EVIDENCE blocker with RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED remains a gate until the consumer handoff is retested against the exact provider source commit.
External deployment, secret, DNS/TLS and real-browser acceptance gates remain explicit and cannot be converted into implementation success by this tooling.
notes: No WS50 child candidate was created by WS39.
No final provider set was selected or frozen.
Fixture commits and fixture contract data are test-only and are not provider authority.
Current moving owner branch heads inspected during development are not recorded as final provider pins.
